description: Source code for a React component that renders GeoJSON data using deck.gl's GeoJsonLayer, including functions for processing GeoJSON features, styling, and viewport fitting.

classes.name: DeckGLGeoJson
classes.description: React component that renders GeoJSON data with deck.gl, supporting styling, labels, icons, and viewport fitting.

methods.name: setTooltipContent
methods.description: Generates tooltip content from feature properties.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Determines fill color for features, highlighting selected features.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object.

methods.name: computeGeoJsonTextOptionsFromJsOutput
methods.description: Extracts text styling options from JavaScript output for deck.gl GeoJsonLayer.

methods.name: computeGeoJsonTextOptionsFromFormData
methods.description: Creates text styling options from form data.

methods.name: computeGeoJsonIconOptionsFromJsOutput
methods.description: Extracts icon styling options from JavaScript output for deck.gl GeoJsonLayer.

methods.name: computeGeoJsonIconOptionsFromFormData
methods.description: Creates icon styling options from form data.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Constructs a deck.gl GeoJsonLayer with processed features and styling based on form data.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Extracts bounding points from GeoJSON features for viewport fitting.
